reply.text:
A hard cut in 3 days is outside what I'll coach. Water and food manipulation that fast is risky, and the right call on how much, if any, is one for a doctor or a sports dietitian who knows your size and your tournament's weigh-in rules. I also won't hand you a number for it.

What I can do is keep your training sharp this week. That means keeping the sessions light and crisp, sleeping well, eating normally, and staying hydrated so you walk in feeling good. If you tell me what you want from the next three days, I'll set up a short session.
